text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 optional post-release extension. Current mvpa-fit has no frozen ProfileHrf readout-field implementation, while required adaptive readout/plan integration remains outstanding. This is not obsolete, but it should not compete with that core path. Existing requirement for total reread/query/reuse comparison is essential: implement operator mode only after a concrete consumer workload shows advantage over materialized beta blocks at equal approximation accuracy. Preserve frozen/fold-scoped coding and routing provenance, conditional adjoint versus adaptive Jacobian distinction, and explicit polynomial-versus-residual-corrected approximation evidence. No promotion from a dot-product test alone; no requirement to implement optional finite-state structure unless that backend is separately admitted. Dependency on PHRF-16 and current P3 remain intact. Source assessment only.
